author: Khan Academy
description:
Engineers use physical models and computer simulations to test designs and predict performance. Controlled, repeated tests provide data for evaluating solutions against criteria and constraints. Engineers combine promising features, optimize designs through repeated testing, and investigate failures to identify limits. Sharing drawings, data, and findings allows others to evaluate, reproduce, and improve solutions.

Sections:
00:00 - How do we test a design before building it?
00:19 - Physical models and computer simulations
01:37 - Build and test the prototype
03:27 - Combine the best parts
04:42 - Optimize and test again
05:14 - Test until failure
06:15 - Share the solution
